caseNameFull: Mathews, Secretary of Health, Education, and Welfare v. Williams

opinions.text:
C. A. 5th Cir. Motion of respondent for leave to proceed in forma pauperis and certiorari granted. Judgment vacated and case remanded for further consideration in light of Mathews v. Eldridge, ante, p. 319.

Mr. Justice Stevens took no part in the consideration or decision of this case.
